title: Scikit-learn Model Predict
source_docs: Statistics and Machine Learning Toolbox/Python Models/Scikit_learn_Model_Predict.md
text: Predict responses using pretrained Python scikit-learn model, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough; {Path to scikit-learn model file} sets the name or path of Python scikit-learn model file, {Sample time (–1 for inherited)} sets the option to specify sample, {Input}, {Output}, {Path to Python file defining preprocess()} sets the name or path of Python preprocessing function file character and {Path to Python file defining postprocess()} sets the name or path of Python postprocessing function file character. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Path to scikit-learn model file
params.values: Name or path of Python scikit-learn model file untitled (default) | character vector

params.name: Sample time (–1 for inherited)
params.values: Option to specify sample time –1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Path to Python file defining preprocess()
params.values: Name or path of Python preprocessing function file character vector

params.name: Path to Python file defining postprocess()
params.values: Name or path of Python postprocessing function file character vector
